# Demo MTC policy file
#
# This policy file configures some of the additional optional features in MTC
# for relying parties. The format is ad-hoc and, for now, put together for demo
# purposes only. It is partly inspired by https://c2sp.org/tlog-policy
#
# This file is optional. If omitted or empty, the verifier will simply check for
# the CA cosigner, analogously to normal X.509.
#
# The file is a sequence of newline-separated commands, where each command is
# separated by whitespace. '#' denotes a comment. Empty or whitespace-only lines
# are ignored. The commands are:
#
# cosigner COSIGNER_ID SIGALG PUBLIC_KEY
#
#   This defines a cosigner with the specified cosigner ID (specified in dotted
#   decimal), signature algorithm, and the public key. The public key is a
#   base64-encoded, DER-encoded SubjectPublicKeyInfo.
#
#   Cosigners from CA certificates are automatically imported. They should not
#   be specified separately.
#
# group GROUP_NAME NUMBER GROUP_OR_COSIGNER_NAME...
#
#   This defines a named cosigner group. A cosigner group is a quorum
#   requirement of cosigners. The requirement is satisfied if at least NUMBER of
#   of the group member requirements is satisfied. Group members may be
#   cosigners or other group names. As shorthand, the keywords "all" and "any"
#   may be used in place of NUMBER.
#
# require-cosigners CA GROUP_OR_COSIGNER_NAME
#
#   This specifies that certificates from one or all CAs must satisfy the named
#   cosigner requirement. CA is either a CA ID (in dotted decimal) or the
#   keyword "all" to specify all CAs. GROUP_OR_COSIGNER_NAME is either the name
#   of a defined cosigner or cosigner group.
#
#   This command may be included multiple times, in which case all requirements
#   must be satisfied.
#
# revoke-range CA MIN_SERIAL MAX_SERIAL
#
#   This specifies that all certificates from CA from MIN_SERIAL to MAX_SERIAL,
#   inclusive, are revoked. CA is a CA ID (specified in dotted decimal). Serial
#   numbers encode both log number and index. They can be specified as either:
#   - a pair of colon-separated decimal integers, LOG:INDEX
#   - a decimal integer, specifying a combined serial number
#   - the keyword "max", specifying 2^64
#
# trusted-subtree CA LOG START END HASH
#
#   This specifies a trusted subtree for some CA. CA is a CA ID (specified in
#   dotted decimal). LOG, START, and END are decimal integers that specify the
#   log number and subtree position. HASH is a base64-encoded hash. Entries
#   contained in this trusted subtree are assumed to satisfy all cosigner
#   requirements.

# Import the cosigners from the demo mtc.json.
cosigner 32473.2.1 ecdsa_p256_sha256 MFkwEwYHKoZIzj0CAQYIKoZIzj0DAQcDQgAEepynk7vjNjsS+xwox/4tPpZyMezhNG9w511lbnvuUwVQ6vGhuiqhavsaa1eZZekLTyW/k0wafir9SEaQ8TKcbQ==
cosigner 32473.2.2 mldsa65 
cosigner 32473.2.3 mldsa87 
cosigner 32473.3.1 mldsa44 
cosigner 32473.3.2 mldsa44 
cosigner 32473.3.3 mldsa44 
cosigner 32473.3.4 mldsa44 

# A sample policy: require at least two independent operators sign it, including
# the CA. One way to model this is to set up groups for each operator.
group operator-A any 32473.3.1
group operator-B any 32473.1 32473.3.2
group operator-C any 32473.3.3 32473.3.4
group operator-D any 32473.2.1 32473.2.2 32473.2.3

group two-independent-operators 2 operator-A operator-B operator-C operator-D
require-cosigners all two-independent-operators

# Since the CA signature is implicitly required, this would have been equivalent
# to just writing a CA-specific policy, omitting the cosigner the CA also
# operates. However, the above policy can be specified once for all CAs.
group independent-cosigner-from-B any operator-A operator-C operator-D
require-cosigners 32473.1 independent-cosigner-from-B

revoke-range 32473.1 1:2100 max

# Landmark subtrees copied out from output of the demo program.
trusted-subtree 32473.1 1    0   32 FuB1S/AVQxq3AkJmS+motlqcwNSi6FOJG3Noa4KaGF4=
trusted-subtree 32473.1 1   32   34 n45YX8aNgPT/JiC5jjTDOE4l1ZF/te899ttPlHJIb5A=
trusted-subtree 32473.1 1    0 1024 XDQGoZVQpbPJTvy/9j/vEbV9+VZIOmw8mmB8As7a1Oc=
trusted-subtree 32473.1 1 1024 2036 nrHwDwyamzxb3tc44WcvnQrcgyHoydtC9FedzUZFQ24=
trusted-subtree 32473.1 1 2032 2048 EhUZWbsNhnFxw1uITvqZyVOXz3uJmHxhMNtGrz4rRaE=
trusted-subtree 32473.1 1 2048 2122 c5G7ogrVRBwqk/VGTvwrJOLovIPf5PL+mcmx3o3El0w=
